dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250313-ECU-02](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250313-ECU-02) A flood occurred on Mar 13 2025 in Ecuador. It affected an estimated 325328 people and 90608 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
